# Differentiation of Integrals (Leibniz Rule)

*   Differentiating parameterized functionals $\frac{d}{d\alpha} \int f \, dx$ through the integral sign.
*   Crucial for understanding how to vary an integral path with respect to a parameter $\alpha$ when deriving the Euler-Lagrange equations.
